slides.heading: CU Biodiversity Garden
slides.text: Calicut University's Biodiversity Garden designated as a heritage site.

slides.heading: Gazette Notification
slides.text: The State government has notified the Calicut University Biodiversity Garden at Tenhipalam in Malappuram district as a 'Biodiversity Heritage Site'.

slides.heading: Historical Significance
slides.text: The garden features tropical India flora and exotic species, inaugurated in 1972 by R.E. Holttum, then Director, Singapore Botanical Garden.
